# Objstore Confmap Provider

<!-- status autogenerated section -->
| Status        |           |
| ------------- |-----------|
| Stability     | [alpha]  |
<!-- end autogenerated section -->

## Summary

This package provides a `ConfigMapProvider` implementation that loads Collector configuration from object storage supported by [`github.com/thanos-io/objstore`](https://github.com/thanos-io/objstore). All providers enabled by the library are supported and enabled.

A custom `objstore` configuration file can be provided via the environment variable `OBJSTORE_CONFIG_PATH`.

## How It Works

- The provider is selected for configuration URIs starting with `objstore:`.
- The URI object name identifies the object path in the storage.
- The URI `type` query parameter identifies the Thanos `objstore` provider type and is **mandatory**.

Expected URI format:

- `objstore:[OBJECT_NAME]?type=[PROVIDER_TYPE]`

Example:

```yaml
--config=objstore:configs/otel.yaml?type=gcs
```

## Objstore Configuration

For a completete reference to the `objstore` configuration, see the [Thanos Storage documentation](https://thanos.io/tip/thanos/storage.md/#supported-clients) or check
out the [Thanos `objstore` package documentation](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/thanos-io/objstore) or refer to the [Thanos `objstore` configuration examples](

Example `objstore` config for the `gcs` provider:

```yaml
# Mounted at /etc/otel/objstore.yaml
type: GCS
config:
  bucket: "my-bucket"
prefix: ""
```

With `OBJSTORE_CONFIG_PATH=/etc/otel/objstore.yaml`, the example above reads the Collector config object `configs/otel.yaml` from the GCS bucket `my-bucket`.
